candidates.why_relevant: Primary publication channel for NBU officials' speeches ('Виступ...'), interviews ('Інтерв'ю...') and press-briefing transcripts. Deputy-Governor speeches routinely pre-announce regulatory direction (e.g. Serhii Kholod on 'conceptual changes in regulating the Ukrainian payment market' / PSD2 transposition) months before a draft act exists. Titles are formulaic, making automated filtering of speech/interview items reliable.

coverage_gaps.description: Spoken content (conference panels, briefing Q&A, webinars) is the defining medium of this cell but is not text-searchable. Only NBU press briefings have reliable video; association and commercial conferences rarely publish recordings.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Stand up an ASR stage for Ukrainian audio over NBU YouTube briefings first (highest volume, most reliable), then extend to any organiser-published event video. Index transcripts with the same rule/deadline keyword set used for text.

coverage_gaps.description: No source was found that systematically tracks which NBU official owns which forthcoming rule. Names surfaced only incidentally (Serhii Kholod — payment market regulation; Andriy Podderiogin — Director, Department of Payment Systems and Innovation Development; Yuriy Heletiy — FX/business dialogue; Serhiy Nikolaychuk — First Deputy Governor, international; Oleksii Shaban — payments; Yaroslav Matuzka).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build and maintain an explicit official-to-topic actor map from conference speaker lists plus the NBU organisational structure page, and use it to route and prioritise incoming speech items. Speaker lists are the cheapest reliable input for this.

coverage_gaps.description: Discovered sources skew to banking and payments/fintech. The non-bank financial services side supervised by the NBU since split-regulation (insurers, credit unions, pawnshops, finance companies) has its own event and association circuit that was not covered in this cell's searches, despite being explicitly affected by the payment-controls draft found here.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up pass on non-bank association events (insurance associations, credit union associations, finance-company bodies) using local terms 'небанківські фінансові установи', 'страховий ринок', 'кредитні спілки', 'фінансові компанії'.

coverage_gaps.description: LinkedIn and Facebook posts by NBU officials and association staff — a heavily used channel in this market for commenting on forthcoming rules — were not systematically explored. Facebook pages for NABU, AUB, UAFIC and PaySpace were seen only as search artefacts.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assess feasibility and ToS/legal position for monitoring public LinkedIn/Facebook posts of a defined shortlist of named officials and association leads, rather than broad social scraping.

coverage_gaps.description: No forward-looking master calendar of Ukrainian banking/fintech events exists among the discovered sources; events were found retrospectively via recaps. Only the NBU monetary-policy schedule provides genuine lead time.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assemble a synthetic event calendar by scraping the recurring organisers found here (NABU, AUB, UAFIC/UAFIN.TECH, Financial Club, BANKIR club, EBA) and normalising their announcements into dated entries, so panels can be captured live rather than reconstructed.

coverage_gaps.description: Russian-language sources were not searched, though a meaningful share of Ukrainian financial trade commentary and event coverage historically appeared in Russian and some archives remain bilingual.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Decide explicitly whether Russian is in or out of scope for this run; if in, add a small ru-term pass over the same organiser set. This is a scope decision, not an oversight, since the run scope specified uk and en only.

brief: For Ukraine A3 weak signals, the landscape is anchored on the NBU's own news feed, which carries speeches, interviews and press-briefing texts under formulaic Ukrainian title prefixes rather than in a dedicated speeches section, and is bot-defended (403 on direct fetch) though clearly live. Around it sits a dense, well-defined conference circuit run by a handful of repeat organisers — the banking associations NABU (nabu.ua, not the anti-corruption bureau) and AUB, the fintech association UAFIC with UAFIN.TECH and Ukraine Fintech Week, the Financial Club round tables, the BANKIR club forums, and the European Business Association's committee meetings with NBU deputy governors — whose agendas and speaker lists name both the rule topics under negotiation and the officials who own them. Trade press (PaySpace Magazine, Banker.ua, Finclub) and Telegram supply the fastest and often the only record of what was actually said on stage. The binding constraint is modality, not availability: the highest-value content is spoken and untranscribed, so ASR over NBU briefing video plus a synthetic forward event calendar would raise this cell's yield more than adding further sites.
